title: Finding the Right Yacht with Jose Noy
description: Miami native Jose Noy brings lifelong boating experience and professional expertise to every yacht sale. From guiding clients through the buying process to matching yachts with their lifestyle, Jose makes finding the perfect vessel seamless and enjoyable.
html:
A Miami Native with Boating in His Blood

Jose Noy’s connection to the water began early. Growing up in Miami, he spent his childhood boating, snorkeling, and enjoying water sports with family and friends. That passion led him to study boats, attend the South Florida boat show regularly, and eventually turn his love for yachting into a career. Today, Jose brings both personal experience and professional knowledge to every client he assists.

43ft Azimut 2016 Above & Beyond

Matching Boats to Your Lifestyle

Jose understands that buying a yacht is about more than just specs and brand names — it’s about creating experiences. Whether clients seek high-speed thrills on the water or relaxing, long-distance cruises, he carefully recommends yachts that fit their vision. From Cigarette Racing 42X for performance seekers to Ferretti 920 for luxury cruising, Jose ensures every recommendation aligns with how clients want to enjoy their time on the water.

Support Every Step of the Way

Navigating the yacht-buying process can be complex, but Jose provides guidance at every stage. From evaluating maintenance, performance, and resale value to coordinating with surveyors and closing teams, he ensures clients make informed, confident decisions. Since joining Florida Yachts International in 2018, Jose has successfully facilitated 44 yacht sales, earning a reputation for dedication and reliability.

74ft Privilege 2010

Real Experience, Real Perspective

Jose’s personal time on the water enriches his professional insight. From learning to drive a boat with his father to favorite trips to Boca Chita Key, he understands the joys and challenges of boating firsthand. This perspective allows him to connect authentically with clients, guiding them toward yachts that fit their lifestyle and expectations.

Why Clients Choose Jose Noy

Working with Jose means partnering with someone who combines passion, knowledge, and commitment. His follow-up, attention to detail, and insider connections within the yachting community give clients confidence and access throughout the buying process.
